title: Replication package for: What can country panels tell us about broadband price responsiveness? Evidence from the European Union and the Eastern Partnership, 2010-2024
description: Code, data and results reproducing every table, figure and number of the article. Country panel of 27 EU and 6 Eastern Partnership countries (ITU price baskets, World Bank indicators, harmonised night-time lights) and a regional panel of 175 EU NUTS-2 regions (Eurostat). Run empirical_economics/code/run_all.py.
